text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected
service: inference-api-eu
route: /v1/stream
p95: 650ms -> 2.4s, p99: 1.8s -> 6.9s
SLO: p99 <= 2s (breach)
monitoring: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/latency/eu-stream?panel=stream
Escalation: paging #eng-oncall

oncall-robin: ack, joining bridge :headphones:
Bridge: https://call.redwood.internal/bridge/5544332211
Anyone already seeing KV cache evictions?

sre-ana: looking at live traces now. KV cache miss rate jumped from 3% -> 42% around 16:22UTC
Streaming queue depth increasing, tail latency spike on gpu nodes eu-rt-gpu[0-3]

eng-runtime-jay: I'm tailing logs on eu-rt-gpu1. Seeing repeated prefix-eviction logs:
```
INF 16:22:41 prefix_cache:evict key=abc123 size=2048 age=120s
WARN 16:22:41 kvcache:miss model=redwood-2b quant=8bit
```
Probably cache thrash due to bursty long-context requests.

support-maya: Support shows 3 customers with active degraded sessions (cust_824, cust_391, cust_129). No errors logged to client side, just long stalls >8s and reconnects.

product-lee: Are we hitting a particular model or request type? Any sudden traffic shift from a partner region?

sre-ana: Traffic mix: spike in long-streaming completions from one partner IP range 34.200.*.* starting at 16:21UTC. Average seq length up ~3x.

oncall-robin: Quick mitigations:
- Enable prefix-caching throttle for streaming routes (limit max_prefix_store=32MB)
- Route new streaming requests from partner subnet to fallback pool in eu-fallback (lower throughput but isolated cache)
- If needed, enforce shorter max_tokens for streaming (temp policy)
I'll run the routing change in 2m.

eng-runtime-jay: prepared rollout snippet:
```
api call: POST /admin/route/update
payload: {"route":"/v1/stream","policy":{"fallback_pool":"eu-fallback","max_prefix_store_mb":32}}
```

sre-ana: running quick KV stats before change: prefix_cache_size=78MB, evictions=1250/min, kv_miss_rate=41%

oncall-robin: rolling policy now -> applying to ingress edge (canary 10%)

deploy-bot: config-change detected: route-update /v1/stream canary=10% (deployed by oncall-robin)

support-maya: early customer telemetry shows p99 down to ~2.2s for canary traffic

eng-runtime-jay: increase canary to 40%... tracing looks stable for canary shards

sre-ana: kv_miss_rate for canary nodes now 7%, total p99 trending to 1.9s

oncall-robin: increasing to 100% and monitoring. Keeping the bridge open for 30m. If p99 stays <=2s, we'll close this incident as mitigated.

product-lee: Noting customer impact and mitigation in incident doc. Will notify accounts for the three affected customers.

support-maya: FYI sent to CSMs for cust_824 and cust_391. cust_129 on edge, pinging support channel.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: MITIGATED (routing fallback + cache throttle). Open action items: postmortem, analyze partner traffic, consider per-tenant cache isolation.

oncall-robin: thanks team. Quick follow-ups: SRE to gather full traces, Eng-runtime to propose permanent guardrails, PM to coordinate customer comms. Closing live bridge.

sre-ana: grabbing traces + will attach in PM thread.

eng-runtime-jay: will draft config changes for per-tenant cache quotas.

support-maya: will compile list of sessions and client-side logs for accounts.

oncall-robin: closing thread, moving tracking to incidents/postmortems/5544332211
:thumbsup:
